Any reason why you set the nopad parameter to TRUE?

As per this document, i don't think we will see a padding between length and string
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-fscc/20406fb1-605f-4629-ba9a-c67ee25f23d2

why are you manually truncating the length? Either the length in the SMB2_FILE_NORMALIZED_NAME_INFO entry is wrong, or the packet was truncated when capturing (by specifying a snaplen) an Wireshark should handle that automatically.

Yes. We needed it to handle the case for `STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW`.
https://devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20080404-00/?p=22863

Current released wireshark version handle it differently (not throwing exception)
